---

**[high, correctness] — upgrade-status.json written but not loaded/rendered by the dashboard.** Fixed the broken consumer path end-to-end. (1) `dashboard/core.js`: added `{ key: 'upgradeStatus', file: 'upgrade-status.json', nullableMissing: true }` to the aliased-files loader, so the always-shown projection is now fetched into dashboard state with the same missing→null honesty contract the other sidecars use. (2) `dashboard/lib/health-logic.js`: added `renderUpgradeStatusCardHTML(proj)` and wired it into `renderHealthHTML`'s `sections` array (right after the header), so the Tools & Setup / Health page now renders the standing row in **every** state — including the positive up-to-date case (D011). The card colors red when `behind_upstream` or `update_state==required_pending`, never reads green while upstream is behind (D031), surfaces `installed_commit` as its own row distinct from the `last_acknowledged` line (D037), and shows "never acknowledged" verbatim from the projection when the marker is absent (D042). All output is `esc()`-escaped.
